prompt: Create a hyper-realistic macro product photograph of a single futuristic transparent earbud, centered vertically against a soft light gray studio background. The earbud has a glossy black inner body with a clear acrylic outer shell wrapping around it, shaped like a long rounded stem attached to an oval earbud head. Include one white silicone ear tip behind the head, slightly out of focus and angled to the right, and one rounded white outer disk behind the black oval face. Add two small perforated silver speaker-grille plates: one near the upper-left area of the head and one near the bottom of the stem. Add exactly one bright red circular button on the upper-right side of the black face. Cover the entire object with many realistic water droplets of varied sizes, including beads on the clear casing, black face, and white silicone parts. Lighting should be cool, diffused, and high-contrast enough to show reflections, refraction through the transparent plastic, fine ridges along the clear shell, and tiny droplets. Use shallow depth of field, premium tech product advertising style, sharp focus on the front earbud surface, no text, no logo, no hands, no extra objects.

promptZh: 创作一张超写实微距产品摄影图，主体为一个未来感透明耳机，垂直居中于柔和的浅灰色摄影棚背景前。耳机内部为亮黑色机身，外层包裹着透明亚克力外壳，整体呈长圆柱形柄连接椭圆形耳机头的形状。在耳机头后方放置一个白色的硅胶耳塞，略微失焦并向右倾斜；在黑色椭圆形面板后方放置一个圆形的白色外盘。添加两块细小的银色穿孔扬声器网罩：一块位于耳机头左上方，另一块位于耳机柄底部。在黑色面板的右上侧添加一个鲜红色的圆形按钮。在整个物体表面覆盖大量大小不一的逼真水珠，包括透明外壳、黑色面板和白色硅胶部件上的水珠。光线应保持冷色调、漫反射，并具有足够的高对比度，以展现反射效果、透明塑料的折射感、透明外壳上的细微纹路以及细小的水珠。采用浅景深，呈现高端科技产品广告风格，焦点清晰地对准前方耳机表面，无文字，无 Logo，无手部，无额外物体。
